hooks.command: cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/core.md"; printf '\nJITTER_ROOT=%s (the rules and the checks in tools/ live there, use this path when a skill asks for it)\n' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*.kicad_pro' -print -quit | grep -q . && python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/kicad_project_check.py" 2>&1 || true
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/comment_lint.py" --hook; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 2 ] && exit 2; fi; exit 0
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/guard_push.py"; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 2 ] && exit 2; fi; exit 0
